title: QL-1.06 The claims check ships to every repository and runs in memev's CI
request: Closes quality-loop principle 4 in every repository (CI fails in any repo, site included, if a claim runs ahead of its row). Split from QL-1.04 at its three-round stop (lead decision under the owner's delegation, 31 October 2026): QL-1.04 keeps task 1, the claims checker; this contract takes QL-1.04's task 2: copying the gate scripts, the status table and the results files into memev-site, memev-cloud, memev-org and memev-ops, memev's own CI run of the checker, and round 3's answers about performance figures, the targets' workflows and the cross-repository job. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: QL-1.04, SR-5.04. Quality-loop principle set of 30 October 2026 (owner's order: implement as a gate for all dev). Sequenced with QL-1.05, which also changes .github/workflows/. The fixtures follow SR-5.04's status table as merged.

tasks.title: Shipped to the other repositories
requirements: scripts/gate/sync-gates.mjs copies scripts/gate/** into a target checkout given by --to and prints the version of each file copied; a target whose copy is older than this repository's is reported
docs/DEVELOPING.md says the gate scripts are owned here and copied into memev-site, memev-cloud, memev-org and memev-ops, and that each of them runs claims.mjs in its CI
sync-gates.mjs copies docs/status.json with the gate scripts, and claims.mjs reads the status table only from the copy in its own checkout

sync-gates.mjs --check writes nothing and exits non-zero naming the file when a target gate file differs in content from this repository's (even at the same version line), is missing, or has no version line; versions compare numerically (1.10 is newer than 1.9), and a newer target copy is reported, never overwritten; docs/status.json, which cannot carry a version line, is exempt from the version-line rule only and is compared by content like every gate file, and so is each results file sync copies

memev's own CI runs claims.mjs over README.md, docs/**/*.md and site/**/*.html, the globs quoted so claims.mjs expands them itself, on every pull request that touches them and on a schedule, so the age rule runs even when nothing changes: the claims step sits in a job whose if: admits both schedule and pull_request, after no step that reads github.base_ref, passes no --now, and the scheduled run has a concurrency group of its own

sync-gates.mjs --check also exits non-zero, naming the repository, when no workflow under the target's .github/workflows/ runs node scripts/gate/claims.mjs; memev's CI has a scheduled job that checks out memev-site, memev-cloud, memev-org and memev-ops read-only, with a read-only token held as a repository secret (an owner step), and runs sync-gates.mjs --to <checkout> --check on each; the job fails, never skips, when the secret is missing
sync-gates copies every results file named in a row of docs/status.json to the same path in the target, so a figure backed in memev is backed in the target

each sentence of README.md, docs/**/*.md and site/**/*.html that gives hardware or limits rather than performance (for example docs/testing/LAB-TEST-PLAN.md's '2 CPUs, 4 GB RAM, 10 GB disk') carries the marker <!-- claims: not a figure --> at the end of its line; apart from docs/DEVELOPING.md and docs/status.json, this task changes those files only by inserting that marker, by inserting the label ' (planned)' into a sentence or at the end of a heading that claims a planned feature, and by correcting or removing a performance figure under the figures rule

every performance figure in README.md, docs/**/*.md and site/**/*.html (at the base: docs/DESIGN.md, docs/SOLUTIONS.md, site/web/solutions.html and docs/testing/LAB-TEST-PLAN.md) is backed by a results file of a bench run committed beside it under bench/results/ and named in its feature's row of docs/status.json, with the figure equal to the value in that file, or is removed until something measures it; no performance figure carries the marker <!-- claims: not a figure -->
sync-gates.mjs refuses a row whose results field breaks QL-1.04's results-file rule (a non-empty .json object under a directory named results) and writes nothing outside --to

sync-gates.mjs --check accepts a target's claims step only when it runs bare node scripts/gate/claims.mjs in a job that admits pull_request and schedule, with no continue-on-error, no '|| true' or '; exit 0', no if: that is false for pull_request, no --status or --now and no NODE_OPTIONS in its job or step env, and with --surfaces (or the default globs) covering every tracked .md, .mdx, .html and .astro file of the target; a YAML comment does not count

the scheduled cross-repository job admits schedule only, never pull_request, pull_request_target or push, and has no continue-on-error; each checkout uses persist-credentials: false, a path of its own and a token taken from a secret; the --check step runs this repository's sync-gates.mjs from the workspace root, never a file inside a checkout; a guard step before the checkouts exits non-zero when the secret is empty

memev's own claims step fails CI when a claim runs ahead of its row: neither the step nor its job has continue-on-error, and its run text has no '|| true', no '| tee' and nothing else that hides claims.mjs's exit code
ci.yml's on.pull_request has no paths filter, or every tracked file under README.md, docs/, site/ and bench/results/ matches its paths and none matches a paths-ignore glob
the change leaves docs/status.json's rows as the base has them apart from their results fields (no row added, removed or re-statused) and removes no ' (planned)' label from README.md, docs/ or site/

sync-gates.mjs --check accepts a target's claims workflow only from an allowlist: on: holds pull_request with no paths, branches or types filter, and schedule; there is no workflow-level env; in the claims job only actions/checkout and actions/setup-node steps come before the claims step; the claims step is the single line node scripts/gate/claims.mjs, optionally with --surfaces, with no shell, working-directory, env or continue-on-error
a scheduled run of ci.yml runs only the claims job and the cross-repository job, and neither reads github.base_ref, github.event.before or github.event.pull_request

the contract closes only when each of memev-site, memev-cloud, memev-org and memev-ops, at its default branch, passes sync-gates.mjs --check, run by the owner with a read-only token; an unset token or owner fails the check, never skips it

every step of the cross-repository job that runs sync-gates.mjs --check fails the job when a target differs: no continue-on-error on the step or the job, and nothing in its run text that hides the exit code
the marker exempts the unit it sits in, a paragraph of a .md file, a table row or a line of an .html file, and such a unit states no figure, time figures in seconds and minutes included

each bench/results file is the output of a run: its top-level keys are exactly those its bench script writes (scripts/growth-bench.mjs or scripts/lab/measure.mjs), and a fresh run gives recall_ms_p50 and recall_ms_p95 within a factor of 2 of the file's, with max_heap_mb no more than heap_bound_mb
sync copies each named results file byte for byte to the same path in the target, never a manifest in its place, so claims.mjs in the target compares each figure with its value
